shared_elements: low-relief carving arranged in stacked horizontal registers
repeated figures aligned along a common ground line
justification: Both surfaces stack profile figures in superimposed horizontal registers separated by plain bands, with quadrupeds in profile and a foliate/tree-like element appearing in each, which is about as generic as relief iconography gets. The subject matter otherwise diverges completely: A shows isolated, boldly schematic wild creatures (predator, birds, snake-like forms, abstract H-shaped signs) with no interaction, while B shows dense files of naturalistically proportioned clothed humans in procession, holding hands and leading led animals.
